question: In a velocity selector, mutually perpendicular electric and magnetic fields are applied. If $E=3.0 \times 10^{4}\text{ V m}^{-1}$ and $B=0.20\text{ T}$, calculate the speed of charged particles that pass through undeflected. Give reason.

options.D: For undeflected motion, $qE=qvB$, so $v=\dfrac{E}{B}=\dfrac{3.0\times10^4}{0.20}=1.5\times10^5\,\text{m s}^{-1}$. At this speed, the electric and magnetic forces are equal and opposite.
